prompts.bald_male: Create a production sprite atlas for a 2D fantasy RPG from these four character references. Exactly 4 FULL BODY characters in a precise 2 columns x 2 rows grid on transparent background, canvas 1024 x 1536 (each cell 512 x 768). Order: top-left HUMAN reference 4, top-right ELF reference 3, bottom-left ORC reference 2, bottom-right DWARF reference 1. All characters must be COMPLETELY BALD on their scalp: smooth shaved heads with NO scalp hair, no sideburn hair, no stubble or shadow indicating scalp hair. Keep dwarf's full brown beard and mustache (beard is not scalp hair). Preserve each race's exact face identity, skin tone, ear shape, tusks, body build, clothing and clear left-facing three-quarter idle pose from the references. Human wears cream tunic olive trousers brown boots, elf muted green tunic dark trousers, orc cream tunic olive trousers, dwarf stocky broad short legs cream tunic. Naked hands relaxed by sides, NO weapons. Crisp authentic pixel art: stepped dark outlines, limited palette, hard flat shadow clusters, no blur, no smooth painting, no glow. Natural slightly lively colors, NOT gloomy. All characters contained within own cell with margin, no overlap, same ground baseline at 95% of cell, top of bald head at 8% of cell, no labels or text. Every pixel outside characters must have transparent alpha. Do not include hair anywhere; modular hair will be added by game separately.
prompts.bald_female: Create female versions of these fantasy game character bases, on a truly transparent background. Match reference 1 exactly for identity, face shapes, race traits, body shapes, clothes, colors and crisp detailed pixel art quality. Remove ALL scalp hair to make customizable BALD female bases: clean smooth bald scalp, NO bangs, strands, ponytails, stubble or dark hair shadows. No beard or mustache. Reference 2 is the matching male bald atlas and shows the required layout. Canvas 1024x1536, precise TWO COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, cell512x768. Order top-left HUMAN woman (cream long-sleeved linen tunic, olive trousers, brown boots), top-right ELF woman (green tunic, dark trousers, pointed ears), bottom-left ORC woman (olive green skin, tusks, short sleeved cream tunic, sturdy muscular build), bottom-right DWARF woman (short stocky build, cream tunic, dark trousers, brown boots). Left-facing three-quarter standing idle, arms relaxed, hands empty, no weapons. Female faces like reference1, practical modest clothing and natural proportions, dwarf distinctly short legs and broad compact body. Align feet at95% each cell and heads at8%, each wholly within cell. Detailed original sprite quality, clean contours, rich natural shading, NO artificial pixel enlargement, NO palette posterization, NO blur. Do not simplify or degrade detail. Transparent alpha outside bodies, no matte, background, shadow, labels or text.
prompts.hairstyles: Prepare a clean modular hairstyle game atlas using these supplied hairstyle sheets. Preserve the sixteen exact styles, angle, detailed shaded pixel art and silhouettes. Image1 supplies styles1-12, image2 supplies styles13-16 lastrow. Output 1536x1536 transparent PNG, EXACT four columns by four rows, equal384x384 cells. Row1 tousled side fringe, side-part swept, curly, swept-back undercut. Row2 curtain medium, shaggy, bob, long straight. Row3 long wavy, ponytail, bun, single side braid. Row4 short spiky, tall spiky crest, voluminous swept crest, spiky fan. All sixteen must be medium chestnut BROWN, including final4 so color can be customized in engine. HAIR ONLY, empty fully transparent face/neck holes; no skin, eyes, ears, heads or bodies. Hair forms a wearable wig with face opening matching left-facing three-quarter bald fantasy characters. Remove ALL numbers, labels, text, stray marks and disconnected debris. Each haircut fully within own cell with at least24px margin. Every haircut centered horizontally, top24pixels, visible hair width about230pixels, long styles may extend nearbottom. Natural rich original-quality sprite shading, no forced coarse pixel enlargement, no posterization, no blur. Keep shading crisp and detailed. Full transparent alpha outside the hair, absolutely no backdrop or drop shadow. Do not add sample faces.
